R("Make Vertical: word captions re-paged","Word captions are re-paged for the narrow frame from the words their pages hold, every correction kept.",[MV,"File ▸ Re-lay Captions for This Canvas"],MVT,("none",),["Kept as placed and named in the summary when it cannot re-lay: Subtitles, a page with no word timings, a style Frame Job does not make, or pages that would not fit","Message: \"Caption track \"Captions 2\" is kept as placed: it holds a page with no word timings.\""],"192 Make Vertical Version",area="captions")
R("Make Vertical: older bundled graphic modules updated","Older copies of the bundled Lower third, Title card, Callout, Bar chart, Counter and Kinetic type are rewritten with the current template in the copy, the old text kept as the module's previous version.",[MV],MVT,("none",),["Applies to copies from before those templates measured themselves by the short side","Applied in place they are left as they are and the summary names each","Message: \"Graphic module \"intro\" is left as it is: it is an older copy of the bundled template \"lower-third\"; Make Vertical updates it only in a copy.\""],"199 Make Vertical Version",area="graphics")
R("Make Vertical: your own canvas-height modules named","A graphic module of your own that sizes itself by the canvas's height is named in the summary and never rewritten.",[MV],MVT,("none",),[],"205 Make Vertical Version",area="graphics")
R("Follow Speaker: Microphones row","A checkbox for each track holding a sound file picks which belong to the people in the shot.",[MV+" ▸ Follow ▸ Speaker ▸ Microphones"],MVT,("none",),["Named by the track; a recorder's or lavalier's file, not a camera","The first four are ticked","Tick two to four"],"213 Follow Speaker: who is on each microphone")
R("Follow Speaker: Faces row","One row per ticked microphone has a pop-up of the faces found in the longest such shot.",[MV+" ▸ Follow ▸ Speaker ▸ Faces"],MVT,OD,["Faces numbered left to right with where each is across the picture: \"Face 1 (42 % across)\""],"217 Follow Speaker: who is on each microphone")
R("Follow Speaker: automatic face-to-microphone match","Frame Job matches each microphone to the face whose mouth moves while it talks and presets the pop-ups when the match is clear.",[MV+" ▸ Follow ▸ Speaker ▸ Faces"],[],OD,["Note: \"Each microphone is matched to the face that talks with it; change one if it is wrong.\"","Check each row names that microphone's person"],"219 Follow Speaker: who is on each microphone")
R("Follow Speaker: Choose a face","When mouths are too still or too small to read, each pop-up says Choose a face and the note asks you to pick each microphone's face yourself.",[MV+" ▸ Follow ▸ Speaker ▸ Faces"],[],("none",),[],"223 Follow Speaker: who is on each microphone")

R("Make Vertical: Analyzing sheet","When movies are not analysed, the sheet says so and Make shows the Analyzing sheet while faces, people and shot changes are found on this Mac, then makes the version.",[MV+" ▸ Make ▸ Analyzing sheet"],[],OD,["Stop makes nothing: no project opens and this one does not change","Center needs no analysis"],"233 Follow Speaker: who is on each microphone")
R("Make Vertical: sheet returns for Speaker after analysis","With Speaker the sheet comes back once analysis is done, with your choices kept, so you can confirm who is on each microphone; nothing is made until you press Make there.",[MV],[],OD,[],"235 Follow Speaker: who is on each microphone")

R("Framing: eases and stays put","The frame eases onto the subject and moves only when the subject leaves the middle of the frame, so a speaker who sways stays put.",[FS,MV],RC,OD,[],"300 "+A)
R("Framing: cuts at shot changes","The frame cuts with the picture at each shot change, landing on the first frame of the new shot.",[FS,MV],RC,OD,[],"302 "+A)
R("Framing: holds when the subject is lost","The frame holds for a second when the subject is lost, so a blink or a turned head changes nothing, then follows someone else in the shot or eases away.",[FS,MV],RC,OD,["Then eases over 0.8 s to the whole picture (where_empty: \"fit\", the default) or the middle (where_empty: \"center\")"],"304 "+A)

R("Undo Reframe Clip","Undo takes the whole framing back in one step.",["Edit ▸ Undo Reframe Clip"],["undo"],("none",),[],"312 "+A)

R("Framing cuts actions around shot changes","A shot change inside an action cuts it in three around the one-frame cut, so a linear volume change sounds exactly as it did and an eased one eases again on each side.",[],RC,("none",),["A speed action, or one a trim left running past the clip's end, is never cut and takes the framing's change across its length instead"],"320 "+A)
R("reframe_clip replace","replace: true starts from the whole picture, removing every position and scale the clip's actions set before framing.",[],RC,("none",),["Volume and everything else stay","An action left with nothing is removed"],"324 "+A)
